title: Massive Supervised Fine-tuning Experiments Reveal How Data, Layer, and Training Factors Shape LLM Alignment Quality

live_model.evidence: Sec (AlpacaEval v2): 'comparing the responses of our fine-tuned models against those of GPT-4-Turbo, and report the win rate...We used gpt-4o-2024-07-18 as the evaluator LLM.'

prompt.note: AlpacaEval v2's standard fixed reference outputs are used for win-rate comparison; no separate GPT-4-Turbo prompt is printed for this paper's own use of it.

claim.metric: none for the live id (used only as AlpacaEval v2's fixed comparison baseline, not itself scored)

data.source: AlpacaEval v2 (805 questions); 1,000+ fine-tuned SFT models and benchmark results released on GitHub per abstract

notes: GPT-4-Turbo appears only as AlpacaEval v2's fixed reference baseline (pre-existing outputs), not re-called by these authors; the reported win-rate is a property of the fine-tuned open models, not of GPT-4-Turbo itself. The evaluator gpt-4o-2024-07-18 is not on the still-callable list.
